facts.fact: Cursor's Free plan is listed at $0 per month.
Cursor's Plus plan is listed at $8 per month.
Cursor's Premium plan is listed at $30 per month and is described as offering 4x the usage of Plus.
Cursor's Super plan is listed at $100 per month and is described as offering 15x the usage of Plus.
Cursor's Ultra plan is listed at $200 per month and is described as offering 50x the usage of Plus.
The Teams plan is listed at $30 or more per user per month.
The Enterprise plan is priced on a custom basis rather than a published figure.
Premium offers 4x the usage of the Plus plan, according to the page.
Super offers 15x the usage of the Plus plan, according to the page.
Ultra offers 50x the usage of the Plus plan, according to the page.
The page states that displayed prices do not include applicable taxes or fees, such as VAT.
facts.quote: Les prix affichés n’incluent pas les taxes ou frais applicables (par exemple, la TVA).

facts.fact: The page states that third-party model usage in Cursor is not included in the displayed monthly prices and must be purchased separately.
facts.quote: L’utilisation des modèles tiers dans Cursor n’est pas incluse dans les prix mensuels affichés et doit être achetée séparément.

facts.fact: The page states that subscriptions can be cancelled at least 24 hours before renewal to avoid additional charges.
facts.quote: au moins 24 heures avant le renouvellement pour éviter des frais supplémentaires

facts.fact: The page states that prices are subject to change.
facts.quote: Les prix sont susceptibles de changer.

facts.fact: The page lists the Premium and higher tiers as including Cloud Agents and automations; the Free and Plus tiers do not.
The page lists a team marketplace for internal rules, skills and plugins as available only on the Teams and Enterprise plans.
facts.quote: Marketplace d’équipe pour les règles, skills et plugins internes

facts.fact: The page lists X Money's effective annual yield as 6.00% with direct deposit (a vendor-listed figure for X Money, not a Cursor feature).
facts.quote:

facts.fact: The page lists X Money cashback as 3% with direct deposit (a vendor-listed figure for X Money, not a Cursor feature).
